reason: I like that the lab is named and the report is on the page, that is what I usually check. But $25 to $30 a month is a lot on my budget when a bottle of magnesium at the store is $10 to $15 and lasts longer.
objection: I forget my vitamins half the time, so I would be paying $25 for a box I might not finish. And it is still 2 capsules every day.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 for the 30 days, or a small trial box so I can see if I actually keep taking it before I pay for a full month.
